template.name: SearchBySystemQueries
template.description: Advanced template for searching templates by their system queries
template.query: query SearchBySystemQueries($systemQueries: [String!], $matchMode: TagMatchMode) { searchTemplates(filter: { systemQueries: $systemQueries, systemQueryMatchMode: $matchMode }) { templates { id identifier name queryName operationType tags complexityScore } totalCount hasNextPage } }
